title: Enforce document-local XSD import authorization
owner: M8 coordinator / assigned isolated import-visibility worker
api_or_output: Correct document-local XSD 1.0 import permission without public or frozen API change

acceptance.description: Reject unchanged original elemZ007 and schZ005 principal references whose import exists only in an included chameleon document. Bind original metadata/input hashes and preserve original earlier compile-valid failures separately. Namespace authorization is local to the declaration source document under Second Edition import rules and W3C4057/5779.

Prove adding an import to the principal authorizes its reference, while an included document retains its own import authorization. Cover absent import, namespace-only import, available/missing optional location, chameleon adoption, nested includes, mutual imports and declaration-order permutations; preserve redefine resolution, source identity, resource denial/cycles, shared charging, quotas, cancellation and disposal.

Pass relevant combined XSD compilation/content/facade/resource suites, normal and true XML-only consumers, all frozen/additive/emitted APIs and planning validation. Record bounded actual allocation evidence for changed compile/reference routes, cold initialization, owned results, warm operation and retained memory with positive controls. No later milestone, quota increase or oracle change.

handoff.summary: Claimed on coordination main after ready/planning197; isolated worker will produce source and controls for review before execution.
